name: YLY-web-PR
description: PR committee edition: offline-first PWA, meetings weighted /30, scores /110 exported into the PRMEMBER template.

paragraphs: The PR committee edition: offline-first PWA where meetings weigh 30 points, scored out of 110 and exported into the real PRMEMBER Excel template.

An offline-first member evaluation dashboard (Web + installable PWA) for the PR committee, built with Clean Architecture. Every evaluator's data lives only on their own device (IndexedDB in the browser) — there is no backend: scores are computed on-device, the committee's real PRMEMBER (1).xlsx Excel template is filled in the browser, and reports are shared through a WhatsApp deep link. A leader dashboard then merges every evaluator's file into one master report.

Part of the YLY evaluation suite. Each committee has its own deployment with its own template and weighting. Its weighting favours presence: meetings are worth 30 points (vs. 10 in the HR and Social Media editions), next to tasks /30 and visits /20. Sibling editions: EHI/HR · OER · Social Media · the original React/Vite prototype lives in YLY-web.
features: 📴 Offline-first — every mutation hits IndexedDB only; refresh or lose the network and the data is still there.
🏆 Leaderboard of all members, sorted by total /110, with percentage and A–F grade badges.
📅 Global events — field visits (name, date, Day/Night shift) and meetings created once and scored per member.
✅ T × Q × D tasks — up to 10 per member, scored on submission, quality and deadline.
🎚️ Category scores (Interaction, Respect Hierarchy, Bonus) — each with its own Save button.

requirements.text: No server, no API keys: WaMeDeepLinkBuilder builds which opens WhatsApp with the report pre-filled (attachments must be added manually).
